fixtures.name: ct
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT k::INTEGER AS id,
  (CASE WHEN k % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 1000003 % 2000000011 - 1000000005)::BIGINT * 1000 END) AS big,
  (CASE WHEN k % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 37 % 255 - 127) END)::BIGINT AS b8,
  (CASE WHEN k % 13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 211 % 65535 - 32767) END)::BIGINT AS b16,
  (CASE WHEN k % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 100003 % 4000000000 - 2000000000) END)::BIGINT AS b32,
  (CASE WHEN k % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k % 401 - 200) * 0.25) END)::DECIMAL(15,2) AS d2,
  (CASE WHEN k % 8 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k % 241 - 120) * 0.5) END)::DECIMAL(4,1) AS d4,
  (CASE WHEN k % 6 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 7919 % 1000000007) - 500000003) * 0.000000001::DECIMAL(10,9) END)::DECIMAL(18,9) AS d9,
  (CASE WHEN k % 10 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 1234567891011 % 100000000000000) * 0.0000000001::DECIMAL(11,10) END)::DECIMAL(38,10) AS d38,
  (CASE WHEN k % 12 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k % 401 - 200) * 0.25) END)::DOUBLE AS f,
  (CASE WHEN k % 14 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k % 97 - 48) / 8.0) END)::DOUBLE AS fr,
  ((k + 1) * 1e17)::DOUBLE AS fbig,
  (CASE WHEN k % 15 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE make_timestamp((-300000000000000 + k * 337123456789)::BIGINT) END) AS ts,
  'v' || k::VARCHAR AS s,
  (k % 5)::INTEGER AS g
FROM range(0, 3000) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 700)

fixtures.name: tm
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT id::INTEGER AS id, g::INTEGER AS g, dt, ts, ts::TIMESTAMP_MS AS ms,
  (CASE WHEN ts IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE make_timestamp_ns(epoch_us(ts) * 1000 + ((id * 131) % 1000 - 500)) END) AS ns,
  ts::TIMESTAMPTZ AS tz, s
FROM (SELECT k AS id, k % 40 AS g,
  (CASE WHEN k % 17 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE DATE '1960-01-01' + ((k * 37) % 30000)::INTEGER END) AS dt,
  (CASE WHEN k % 13 = 0 THEN NULL
        WHEN k % 50 = 1 THEN TIMESTAMP '1964-03-05 00:00:00' + to_days(((k * 11) % 20000)::INTEGER)
        WHEN k % 50 = 2 THEN TIMESTAMP '1964-03-06 00:00:00' + to_days(((k * 11) % 20000)::INTEGER) - INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND
        ELSE TIMESTAMP '1950-01-01 00:00:00' + to_microseconds(((k * 7919) % 1000000007)::BIGINT * 2800000 + k) END) AS ts,
  'v' || k::VARCHAR AS s
FROM range(0, 3000) t(k)) u) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 700)

  (1, DATE '2020-01-01', DATE '2020-03-01', TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2020-01-02 03:00:00'),

  (3, DATE '2020-01-01', '-infinity'::DATE, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00', '-infinity'::TIMESTAMP),
  (4, NULL, DATE '2020-03-01', NULL, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00'),
